# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** 16  <sub>[v3 c23 P6](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0006), [v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston, United States  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** Poet  <sub>[v4 c3 P33](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0033), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>
- **Titles:** Teacher  <sub>[v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Paul  <sub>[v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul has very dark blue eyes and exquisite, delicate, and refined features. As a young boy, his face was framed by chestnut curls. By age sixteen, he has grown into six feet of manhood, with his curls replaced by close-cropped brown locks.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c19 P26](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0026), [v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002), [v4 c3 P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030)_

## Personality

Paul is a highly imaginative, sweet, and gentle boy who possesses a rare, subtle soul akin to Anne Shirley's. Though grave, thoughtful, and full of dreams and fancies, he is also manly, fair-minded, clean, and capable of holding his own in games and tussles. He is protective toward younger schoolmates and displays deep affection and loyalty toward those he loves.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c8 P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 c8 P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c23 P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005)_

## History

Paul Irving came from Boston to Avonlea to live with his grandmother after his mother died. He became a pupil of Anne Shirley at the Avonlea school, where the two instantly recognized each other as kindred spirits and formed a deep, lasting bond. During his schooldays, Paul defended his American patriotism in a fight with St. Clair Donnell, protected the younger pupils, and developed a childhood affection for Gracie Andrews. He later welcomed his father, Stephen Irving, back to Avonlea and rejoiced when his father reunited with and married Miss Lavendar Lewis, providing Paul with a new mother. As he grew into a tall young man of sixteen, Paul became active in football and began publishing poetry in magazines. He drove Anne and Gilbert Blythe to the train station on their wedding day, and later promised Anne he would visit her at Four Winds.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004), [v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005), [v2 c27 P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 c28 P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 c29 P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v3 c40 P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002), [v4 c3 P33](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0033), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016), [v4 c17 P28](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0028)_
